response.text:
I can’t run work in the background or message you later unless you set up an automation or give me access to a scheduling tool — I’m not able to continue after this turn. I can, however, do the work right now or help you arrange a reminder. Which would you prefer?

Options:
- I’ll start working on it now (best if you paste the task details or upload any files). Tell me the scope, deliverable format, and deadline and I’ll complete as much as I can in this session.
- I’ll draft a clear task plan and a reminder/notification message you can copy into your phone/calendar app (or I can give step-by-step instructions for creating that reminder).
- I’ll prepare a progress checklist and a deliverable template so it’s easy to resume later.

Tell me:
1) What exactly should I work on? (paste files/instructions or describe)
2) Desired output (summary, report, slides, code, etc.)
3) Deadline or how long you want me to spend now
4) Any priorities or constraints

Once you send those I’ll begin immediately.
